entities.name: Gobakhan
entities.description: Desert plane with twin suns surrounded by two diamond sandstorms.

entities.name: Order of the Shieldmage
entities.description: Monks who protect Gobakhan from diamond storms.

entities.name: Teyo Verada
entities.description: Planeswalker who used to be an acolyte of the Order of the Shieldmage.

entities.name: Oasis
entities.description: One of the bigger towns on Gobakhan.

entities.name: Eastern Cloud
entities.description: Perpetual sandstorm of diamond grains, source of air-djinni.

entities.name: Western Cloud
entities.description: Wall of diamond storms, source of fire-djinni.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Gobakhan was a target.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Invader whose progress the diamond storms hampered.

events.summary: Phyrexia invaded Gobakhan; the diamond storms hampered them until they compleated some shieldmages.
events.quote: The plane's diamond storms hampered Phyrexia’s progress until they compleated some of the local shieldmages.

relations.quote: The planeswalker Teyo Verada used to be an acolyte of that order.
